id: 29_Significance of lab hazards in terms of personal microbiology laboratory hazard
title: 实验室危害，伤的是谁
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/29_Significance of lab hazards in terms of personal microbiology laboratory hazard.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/29_Significance of lab hazards in terms of personal microbiology laboratory hazard/src.py

points.K3: 呼吸、皮肤、过敏、中毒、感染
points.K11: 培训让人会识别、会应对
points.K13: 职业安全：安全的工作环境
points.S4: 过道不堆物，线缆不横地

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己，身旁浮现一个人形轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to itself; beside it floats a simple person outline with a shield icon.
shots.narration: 今天说说危害对每个人的影响。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室，阿杰揉着眼睛，桌上堆满培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Late evening in the lab, the young male student rubs his tired eyes at a bench crowded with culture dishes.
shots.narration: 阿杰连着三天赶实验。

shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套直接去拿离心管，脚边地上有电线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls off his gloves to grab tubes faster, a power cord lying across the floor by his feet.
shots.narration: 嫌麻烦，手套也不想戴了。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，伸手拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and gently stops him with a raised hand.
shots.narration: 小研说：危害最后都落在人身上。

shots.scene: 欣欣在两人中间举起一块分成八格的空白板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank board divided into eight squares, each with a small icon.
shots.narration: 我们分八个方面看一看。

shots.scene: 实验台旁站着几个人形图标，台上闪出警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Several person outlines stand around a lab bench where small warning triangle icons glow. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的危害，

shots.scene: 警示三角的箭头一一指向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from the warning triangles point toward each person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 最终都会落到做实验的人身上。

shots.scene: 三个图标：烧瓶、微生物、滑倒小人
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a flask, a microbe, and a slipping figure. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，健康风险。

shots.scene: 三个图标的箭头汇向人形图标，人形变红
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from a flask, a microbe and a slipping figure converge on a person outline that turns red. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理危害都会伤身体。

shots.section_title: 呼吸、皮肤、过敏、中毒、感染
shots.scene: 人形图标的肺、皮肤处出现红点
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with red spots on the lungs and on the skin of the arm. No people.
shots.narration: 轻的呛咳、皮肤发红发痒，
overlay: 呼吸、皮肤、过敏、中毒、感染

shots.section_title: 呼吸、皮肤、过敏、中毒、感染
shots.scene: 人形图标打喷嚏，起疹子
shots.prompt_en: A person outline sneezing with a rash on the hands. No people.
shots.narration: 有人还会过敏。

shots.section_title: 呼吸、皮肤、过敏、中毒、感染
shots.scene: 骷髅象形图和病菌图标，旁边红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A skull and crossbones pictogram and a germ icon with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 重的会急性中毒或被感染。

shots.scene: 离心机盖子没盖好的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a centrifuge with its lid left open, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，意外伤害。

shots.scene: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落三个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a figure slipping on a wet floor, a figure tripping over a cord, and a figure falling from a stool. No people.
shots.narration: 设备用错，滑倒、绊倒、摔倒，

shots.scene: 碎玻璃、针头、刀片图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of broken glass, a needle and a blade. No people.
shots.narration: 还有碎玻璃和针头这些锐器。

shots.scene: 手指上的小创可贴和膝盖上的淤青
shots.prompt_en: A small bandage on a fingertip and a bruise on a knee, drawn as simple icons. No people.
shots.narration: 轻的是小割伤、淤青，

shots.scene: 包着绷带的手臂和打着夹板的腿图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bandaged forearm and a leg in a splint. No people.
shots.narration: 重的伤口深，甚至骨折。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，人形图标慢慢变灰
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a person outline slowly turns grey. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，看不见的远期影响。

shots.scene: 致癌危害象形图和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A health hazard pictogram with a chest-burst silhouette next to a biohazard sign. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触致癌物或生物因子，

shots.scene: 一条缓缓上升的风险曲线
shots.prompt_en: A risk curve rising slowly over a long timeline. No people.
shots.narration: 患慢性病的风险会慢慢升高。

shots.scene: 人形图标的肺、头部、细胞团三处标红
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with red highlights on the lungs, the head, and a small cluster of cells. No people.
shots.narration: 比如癌症、呼吸系统疾病，

shots.scene: 大脑图标上出现闪烁的红线
shots.prompt_en: A brain icon with flickering red lines. No people.
shots.narration: 还有神经系统的损害。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶盖好，放回通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student caps a reagent bottle and puts it back inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 所以少接触、少暴露最重要。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验台前，头顶乌云
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a bench with a small dark cloud above his head.
shots.narration: 第四，心理也会受影响。

shots.scene: 三个表情：紧张、焦虑、害怕
shots.prompt_en: Three face icons: tense, anxious and scared. No people.
shots.narration: 担心出事，会紧张、焦虑、害怕，

shots.scene: 防护缺失、事故警示两个图标，箭头指向乌云
shots.prompt_en: An empty PPE hook and an accident warning icon, with arrows pointing to a dark cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不到位或出过事，更明显。

shots.scene: 手套、护目镜、实验服、呼吸防护四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: gloves, safety goggles, a lab coat, and a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，个人防护装备。

shots.scene: 小研对镜扣好实验服、戴上护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buttons her lab coat and puts on goggles and gloves in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 每次进实验都要穿戴好，

shots.scene: 阿杰重新戴上手套，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his gloves back on while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 这是挡在危害前面的一层墙。

shots.scene: 实验服敞着、护目镜挂在额头的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an unbuttoned lab coat and goggles pushed up on the forehead, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴不对，等于没戴；

shots.scene: 空空的手套盒和空挂钩，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: An empty glove box and an empty coat hook with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用品缺了，暴露风险就上升。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上记下补货
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes a restock note on a blank form beside a supply cabinet.
shots.narration: 缺了及时报，补齐再做。

shots.section_title: 培训让人会识别、会应对
shots.scene: 王老师给学生们上安全课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a lab safety class to the young male student and other students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 第六，培训和安全意识。
overlay: 培训让人会识别、会应对

shots.section_title: 培训让人会识别、会应对
shots.scene: 放大镜找出警示三角，再出现一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass finds a warning triangle, then a shield icon appears over it. No people.
shots.narration: 学会识别危害，也学会控制它。

shots.scene: 没学过的人形图标伸手去按仪器按钮，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An untrained person outline reaching for an instrument button, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没经过培训就上手，

shots.scene: 仪器冒烟、人形图标受伤
shots.prompt_en: An instrument letting out a puff of smoke and a person outline holding an injured hand. No people.
shots.narration: 事故和伤害就容易找上门。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白培训记录上签名
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank training record held by the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 先培训，再动手。

shots.section_title: 职业安全：安全的工作环境
shots.scene: 整洁明亮的实验室全景
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a clean, bright, well-organized microbiology lab. No people.
shots.narration: 第七，职业安全。
overlay: 职业安全：安全的工作环境

shots.section_title: 职业安全：安全的工作环境
shots.scene: 老李检查通风柜和灭菌器，手持空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a fume hood and an autoclave with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 环境安全、设备完好，

shots.section_title: 职业安全：安全的工作环境
shots.scene: 人形图标头顶一颗绿色爱心
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with a green heart above its head, next to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人才能少出事、少生病。

shots.scene: 天平一端是实验台，一端是家和床
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a lab bench on one side and a small house with a bed on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 第八，工作与生活的平衡。

shots.scene: 天平严重倾向实验台，人形图标电量见底
shots.prompt_en: The balance tips heavily toward the lab bench; a person outline shows an almost empty battery icon. No people.
shots.narration: 防护差、压力大，人会被拖垮，

shots.scene: 阿杰趴在桌上，表情沮丧
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps at a desk looking discouraged.
shots.narration: 倦怠，对工作也没了热情。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍阿杰的肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the young male student on the shoulder.
shots.narration: 心里压力大，别一个人扛。

shots.scene: 三个图标：导师、心理咨询室的门、电话
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a teacher figure, a counseling room door with a heart, and a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 找导师谈，找学校心理咨询。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师说出担心的隐患
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the safety administrator about a worry, pointing toward the lab.
shots.narration: 担心的隐患，说出来，一起解决。

shots.scene: 阿杰手指被碎玻璃划了一道小口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a small cut on his finger near a piece of broken glass.
shots.narration: 小伤也别不当回事。

shots.scene: 小研打开墙上的急救箱，帮他冲洗、包扎
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a wall-mounted first aid kit and helps him rinse and bandage the cut.
shots.narration: 先清洗包扎，

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白事故登记本上写记录，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in a blank incident logbook and hands it to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 再报告、登记，需要就去就医。

shots.scene: 带血的碎玻璃被夹进利器盒
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers place the broken glass into a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 伤人的碎玻璃，进利器盒。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着钟表，想跳过穿戴防护的步骤，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances at a clock and tries to skip putting on goggles; the action is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 越赶进度，越容易出事。

shots.scene: 空白流程卡，每一步旁有勾，安全步骤画了盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card with check marks beside each step; the safety steps are marked with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全步骤一步不省，

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在空白日历上排好实验时间
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student plan experiment times on a blank calendar.
shots.narration: 提前排好时间，按时休息。

shots.section_title: 过道不堆物，线缆不横地
shots.scene: 过道上堆着纸箱，地上横着电线，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab aisle blocked by cardboard boxes with a power cord lying across the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 滑倒绊倒，常因过道乱。
overlay: 过道不堆物，线缆不横地

shots.section_title: 过道不堆物，线缆不横地
shots.scene: 老李把电线沿墙收好，纸箱搬走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer routes the power cord along the wall and carries the boxes away.
shots.narration: 过道清空，线缆沿墙走，

shots.section_title: 过道不堆物，线缆不横地
shots.scene: 地上一滩水，小研立好防滑提示牌并擦干
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a wet floor sign by a puddle and wipes it dry.
shots.narration: 地上有水，马上擦干。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：手册、讲台、握手的人群
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands before three icons: a blank manual, a podium, and a group of people holding hands.
shots.narration: 所以要做到三件事：

shots.scene: 王老师、老周、小研、阿杰站在一起
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand together in the lab.
shots.narration: 有规程、有培训，人人讲安全。

shots.scene: 八格板逐格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The eight-square board lights up square by square. No people.
shots.narration: 健康、伤害、远期影响、心理，

shots.scene: 八格板后四格高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last four squares of the board are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 防护、培训、环境、平衡。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，按时关灯离开实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, properly dressed in lab coat and goggles, finishes on time and switches off the lab light as he leaves.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：保护好自己，才能做好实验！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 安全第一，我们下次见！
